record.context_brief: wild extension of Hitchin-fibration and gerbe invariants
record.original_question: Can work on the Hitchin fibration and on stringy invariants twisted by mu_n-gerbes be extended to the wild case?

evidence.quote: Problem 10.4. Generalize the works [GWZ20, LW21] on the Hitchin fibration and stringy invariants twisted by µn -gerbes to the wild case.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $C$ be a smooth projective complex curve and consider the moduli space $\mathcal{M}_n^d$ of stable Higgs bundles $(E,\varphi)$ on $C$ of rank $n$ and degree $d$, where $\varphi: E \to E \otimes K_C$ is a Higgs field with values in the canonical bundle. The Hitchin map $h: \mathcal{M}_n^d \to \bigoplus_{i=1}^n H^0(C, K_C^{\otimes i})$, sending $(E,\varphi)$ to the coefficients of the characteristic polynomial of $\varphi$, exhibits $\mathcal{M}_n^d$ as an integrable system whose generic fibers are abelian varieties. There are natural $\mu_n$-gerbes on the $\mathrm{SL}_n$ and $\mathrm{PGL}_n$ versions $\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{SL}_n}^d$ and $\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{PGL}_n}^d$ of these moduli spaces, arising from the obstruction to lifting universal projective bundles, and these gerbes are dual under the Langlands/SYZ-type mirror symmetry between the two sides.

Known results establish, via $p$-adic integration, that the stringy $E$-polynomials of $\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{SL}_n}^d$ and $\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{PGL}_n}^d$ twisted by these dual $\mu_n$-gerbes agree, confirming a topological mirror symmetry conjecture for the tame Hitchin system, and analogous statements have been proved for parabolic Higgs bundles with tame (regular singular) parabolic structure at a finite set of points.

Now allow Higgs fields with poles of arbitrary order (irregular/wild singularities) at a divisor $D \subset C$, with prescribed local irregular types, giving the wild Hitchin moduli space $\mathcal{M}_n^{d,\mathrm{wild}}$ together with its $\mathrm{SL}_n$ and $\mathrm{PGL}_n$ variants and the corresponding $\mu_n$-gerbes.

Problem: Establish topological mirror symmetry in this wild setting. Specifically, prove that the stringy $E$-polynomials (or, more generally, the appropriate stringy/$p$-adic motivic invariants) of $\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{SL}_n}^{d,\mathrm{wild}}$ and $\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{PGL}_n}^{d,\mathrm{wild}}$, twisted by the dual $\mu_n$-gerbes, are equal, thereby extending the $p$-adic integration / gerby stringy invariants approach to the Hitchin fibration to the wild case.
artifact.category_tag: Wild Hitchin fibration and gerby mirror symmetry
artifact.status_search_result: Topological mirror symmetry for SL_n/PGL_n Hitchin systems via p-adic integration and μ_n-gerbe-twisted stringy invariants is established in the tame case (Groechenig–Wyss–Ziegler 2020) and for parabolic Higgs bundles (Loeser–Wyss 2021). No published work appears to extend these gerby stringy-invariant / p-adic integration results to the wild (irregular singular) Hitchin moduli spaces; the problem appears to be open.

status_evidence.title: Mirror symmetry for moduli spaces of Higgs bundles via p-adic integration
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes topological mirror symmetry for SL_n and PGL_n Higgs moduli with μ_n-gerbe twists via p-adic integration in the tame case.
status_evidence.claim: The gerby stringy E-polynomial equality is proved in the tame case, providing the baseline that the wild generalization seeks to extend.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in the wild McKay correspondence and related fields
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses extending stringy invariants to wild settings and lists related open problems.
status_evidence.claim: Wild generalizations of stringy/McKay-type invariants in this circle of ideas are flagged as open directions.
